description: This file implements the core logic for managing audio input/output, keyword detection, session handling, and resource management for the XR Speech Router's XRAudio component. It includes functions for creating/destroying audio objects, handling device updates, starting/stopping streams, processing keyword detection events, and converting audio formats.

classes.name: xrsr_xraudio_obj_t
classes.description: Main structure representing an XR Audio object, including state, device info, and configuration.

classes.name: xrsr_xraudio_stream_t
classes.description: Represents an individual audio stream, tracking activity, detection status, and statistics.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new XR Audio object with specified parameters.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_destroy
methods.description: Destroys an XR Audio object, releasing resources.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_object_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if an XR Audio object is valid based on its identifier.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_power_mode_update
methods.description: Updates the power mode of the XR Audio object, reinitializing device as needed.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_privacy_mode_update
methods.description: Enables or disables privacy mode on the XR Audio object.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_privacy_mode_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current privacy mode status.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_keyword_detect_sensitivity_limits_get
methods.description: Gets the minimum and maximum sensitivity limits for keyword detection.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_session_request
methods.description: Requests a new audio session with specified format and parameters.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_input_source_fd_set
methods.description: Sets a file descriptor as an audio input source.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_format_to_xrsr
methods.description: Converts an internal audio format to the project-specific format.

methods.name: xrsr_xrsr_format_to_xraudio
methods.description: Converts a project-specific audio format to the internal format.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_stream_begin
methods.description: Starts an audio stream with specified parameters and configuration.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_stream_end
methods.description: Ends an active audio stream, optionally retrieving statistics.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_keyword_detect_params
methods.description: Adjusts keyword detection sensitivity parameters.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_keyword_detect_restart
methods.description: Restarts keyword detection.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_keyword_detect_start
methods.description: Begins keyword detection on the current audio object.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_keyword_detect_stop
methods.description: Stops keyword detection.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_keyword_detected
methods.description: Handles a detected keyword event, initiating session start.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_keyword_detect_error
methods.description: Handles errors during keyword detection, possibly restarting detection.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_device_update
methods.description: Updates device input/output configuration based on source array.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_local_mic_type_get
methods.description: Retrieves available local microphone devices and sets global variables.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_session_capture_start
methods.description: Starts capturing audio session to a file.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_session_capture_stop
methods.description: Stops audio session capture.

methods.name: xrsr_xraudio_thread_poll
methods.description: Performs thread polling for the audio object.
